nosotros.title: About — D.TEX Mallorca
nosotros.description: Textile distributor in Mallorca since 2010. Specialists in custom foam cutting and professional upholstery materials.
nosotros.h1: Specialists in foam and upholstery materials
nosotros.lead: Since 2010 we have supplied upholsterers, furniture manufacturers, marine companies and hospitality projects with everything they need: custom foam, fabrics, faux leather, PVC and accessories, with delivery to all islands.
nosotros.storyP1: D.TEX Mallorca was founded in 2010 with the aim of providing a serious and professional service to the upholstery sector in the Balearic Islands. Two entrepreneurs with decades of experience in textiles launched a distributorship that is now the reference in the archipelago.
nosotros.storyP2: Over time we have become the go-to supplier for custom foam in the Balearics. We cut foam to any dimension, including by volume (m³) and in high densities — a capability that very few can offer. In fact, other distributors who offer foam cutting buy from us to fulfil their orders.
nosotros.storyP3: Around that core we have built a complete range of upholstery materials — fabrics, faux leather, PVC, fibres and accessories — so that our clients can complete any project from a single supplier, without wasting time or taking on coordination risk.

services.name: Upholstery fabrics
services.text: Wide variety of textures, colours and styles — from durable options for high-turnover furniture to elegant fabrics for interior design projects. Available by the linear metre or full roll.

services.name: Faux leather & PVC
services.text: Excellent alternative to natural leather with varied finishes, easy cleaning and high durability. PVC is ideal for outdoor use: resistant to water, mould and UV rays. Available in multiple colours for furniture, vehicle and boat upholstery.

services.name: Accessories & supplies
services.text: Everything the workshop needs: tacks, adhesives, webbing, velcro, threads, staples, rings, curtain rails and fixing systems. Specialist marine materials for boat projects.

services.name: Island-wide delivery
services.text: Daily distribution service to Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera. Efficient delivery in optimal condition so the workshop never stops.

list: Registered address: C/ 4 de Noviembre, 4, Polígono Industrial Can Valero, 07011 Palma de Mallorca, Balearic Islands (Spain)

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
paragraphs: Order requests (Client Area): business name, phone and/or email contact details, and the content of the request (products, quantities, notes) you send us from the Client Area.

Login session: the Client Area and admin back-office use a shared, non-personal password — the session created when you sign in does not identify a specific individual, it only keeps authorised access active.
We do not process navigation data for analytics or advertising purposes: our web analytics is aggregate and does not use tracking cookies (see the Cookie Policy).

sections.heading: 3. Purpose of processing
paragraphs: Managing and responding to order requests submitted from the Client Area.
Maintaining authorised access to the Client Area and the Site's admin back-office.

sections.heading: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: Processing of the request data is based on taking pre-contractual steps at your request (Art. 6.1.b GDPR). Maintaining the login session is based on our legitimate interest in providing the Client Area securely (Art. 6.1.f GDPR).

sections.heading: 5. Retention period
paragraphs: [Pending confirmation from the business/its gestor] Provisionally, we retain each request's data for as long as the resulting business relationship lasts and, in any case, for the periods legally required for tax and accounting purposes.

sections.heading: 6. Recipients and international transfers
paragraphs: We do not share your data with third parties for purposes other than managing your request. [Pending confirmation] the hosting and database providers behind the Site may involve processing data outside the European Economic Area; this policy will be updated with exact detail once the final infrastructure is confirmed.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, as well as to request restriction of processing, object to it, and exercise the right to data portability. You can exercise these rights by writing to administracion@ditexmallorca.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) if you believe the processing does not comply with applicable regulations.

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy to reflect legal changes or changes to how the Site works. The last-updated date appears at the top of this document.

cookies.intro: A cookie is a small file a website stores in your browser. This Site only uses the technical cookies necessary for it to function — we do not use analytics, advertising or social-media cookies.

cookies.whyNoBannerHeading: Why you won't see a cookie banner
whyNoBannerParagraphs: Under the applicable rules (Art. 22.2 of Spain's LSSI and the criteria of the European Data Protection Board, as applied by the Spanish AEPD), cookies that are strictly necessary to provide a service expressly requested by the user — such as keeping a session signed in or remembering a language — are exempt from the consent requirement. Every cookie on this Site falls into that category, so we don't show any consent banner.

This is a deliberate change from the previous site, which used Google Analytics and social-media cookies (Instagram, LinkedIn) and therefore did require a banner. This Site's analytics are aggregate and don't use tracking cookies — a direct benefit of that change (see ADR-0012).
cookies.manageParagraph: You can delete or block these cookies from your browser settings, though doing so may affect your Client Area session or our ability to remember your preferred language.
